entity.summary: Centralized cryptocurrency exchange operating since 2018 and providing current spot, futures, conversion, staking, launchpad, wallet, and payment-related services through the PointPay ecosystem.
entity.notes: Current first-party exchange surfaces expose spot and futures trading, conversion, staking, launchpad, wallet, card and bank purchase options, P2P services, and current market pages. First-party anniversary and product materials state that PointPay has operated since 2018. Current independent exchange data reports recently updated markets, non-zero volume, and registration in Saint Vincent and the Grenadines. Public terms identify PointPay Limited and include region-specific service restrictions, so HEI does not generalize any regulatory authorization across all jurisdictions. January 1 is used only as a year-level launch marker.
